title: Movement Week
tagline: Two weeks of joyful, everyday movement.
description: Walk, run, cycle or train your way to 300 active minutes. Every form of movement counts, so pick what you love and keep showing up.
objective: Accumulate 300 minutes of movement across any combination of walking, running, cycling or exercise sessions.
guidelines: Log sessions of at least 5 minutes in minutes.
Mix activity types to keep things fresh.
Warm up gently and move at a pace that feels comfortable.
Only log activities you completed yourself.
requirements: Reach 300 total minutes before the end date.
Activities must be logged in minutes to count.
Only activities dated inside the challenge window count.

title: Step Up Sprint
description: A friendly step challenge that turns commutes, calls and coffee runs into progress. Average roughly 7,000 steps a day to finish strong.
objective: Walk a total of 150,000 steps during the three-week sprint.
guidelines: Log walks in steps using your phone or watch count.
Combine short walks into a single daily entry if you prefer.
Walking meetings absolutely count.
requirements: Reach 150,000 total steps.
A single entry can record up to 40,000 steps.
Steps must be logged within 13 days of the walk.

title: Hydration Habit
description: Build an easy, lasting hydration routine. Drink at least eight glasses of water on fourteen different days during the month.
objective: Reach eight glasses of water on 14 separate days.
guidelines: Log water in glasses (about 250 ml each).
Several entries on the same day are added together.
Keep a bottle at your desk as a visual cue.
requirements: Log 8 or more glasses on 14 different days.
Only hydration entries in glasses count toward the daily total.

title: Mindful Mornings
tagline: Ten quiet minutes to start the day.
description: Start each morning with a short meditation or breathing practice. Complete 21 mindful days within four weeks to build a habit that sticks.
objective: Meditate for at least 10 minutes on 21 different days.
guidelines: Any guided or unguided practice counts.
Find a consistent time and a quiet spot.
Missed a day? Simply begin again tomorrow.
requirements: Log 10 or more meditation minutes on 21 different days.
Entries must be logged in minutes.

title: Desk Stretch Breaks
description: Interrupt long sitting sessions with gentle stretching or yoga. Collect 150 minutes of stretch breaks over two weeks.
objective: Accumulate 150 minutes of stretching or yoga.
guidelines: Aim for short 5 to 10 minute breaks every couple of hours.
Move gently and never stretch into discomfort.
Invite a teammate to join your break.
requirements: Reach 150 total minutes of stretching or yoga.
Entries must be logged in minutes.

title: Screen-Free Evenings
tagline: Reclaim an hour of your evening.
description: Put the screens away for at least an hour each evening. Read, cook, talk or simply rest. Complete ten screen-free evenings.
objective: Spend 60 or more screen-free minutes on 10 different evenings.
guidelines: Choose a consistent wind-down window.
Charge your phone outside the room you relax in.
Log the total screen-free minutes for the evening.
requirements: Log 60 or more screen-free minutes on 10 different days.

title: Healthy Plate
description: Cook or choose 30 colourful, balanced meals with plenty of vegetables, whole grains and fruit. No calorie counting, just better choices.
objective: Log 30 balanced meals during the challenge.
guidelines: A balanced plate includes vegetables, a whole grain and a protein source.
Home-cooked and canteen meals both count.
This is about choices, not restriction.
requirements: Log 30 meals in total.
A maximum of 6 meals can be logged per entry.

title: 5K Run Club
description: Join the Brightside run club for a month of easy runs. Run, jog or run-walk your way to 40 kilometres at your own pace.
objective: Run a total of 40 kilometres in 30 days.
guidelines: Run-walk intervals are welcome.
Log distance in kilometres.
Rest days are part of training.
requirements: Reach 40 total kilometres.
Runs must be logged in kilometres to count.

title: Gratitude Journal
tagline: Two weeks of noticing the good.
description: Spend five minutes each day writing down what went well. A simple practice for a more positive outlook.
objective: Journal for at least 5 minutes on 14 different days.
guidelines: Write three things you are grateful for.
Paper or digital journals both count.
requirements: Log 5 or more journaling minutes on 14 different days.

title: Autumn Ride Challenge
description: Our September cycling challenge celebrated commuting and weekend rides. Thank you to everyone who rode with us.
objective: Cycle a total of 120 kilometres in September.
guidelines: Wear a helmet and follow local traffic rules.
Log distance in kilometres.
requirements: Reach 120 total kilometres.

title: Walk and Talk Fridays
description: Swap one meeting room booking a week for a walking conversation. Currently paused while we review the format with team leads.
guidelines: Choose a safe, quiet route.
Share an agenda before you leave.
requirements: Reach 120 walking minutes.

title: Winter Wellness Kickoff
tagline: A gentle reset for the colder months.
description: A three-week blend of hydration, movement and rest to welcome winter. Draft: details are still being finalised.
objective: Accumulate 400 active minutes across any wellness activity.
guidelines: Dress warmly for outdoor sessions.
Indoor workouts are equally welcome.
requirements: Reach 400 total minutes.
